Confirmation.successSubtitle: Your card payment has been confirmed. A confirmation email is on its way.
Confirmation.orderRefCopy: Keep this reference for your tracking and customer support requests.
Confirmation.step1Desc: Our licensed veterinarian conducts the final pre-travel health check, issues the EU passport, and verifies the ISO microchip.
Confirmation.step2Desc: Our authorized climate-controlled pet courier contacts you with the precise delivery time window.
Confirmation.step3Desc: Track your companion's transport progress in real time via our Adopter Tracking Portal.
Confirmation.cancelSubtitle: Your card payment was not completed and you have not been charged.
Confirmation.pendingSubtitle: Your payment is still being confirmed by the card processor. This page updates automatically once confirmation is received; you will also receive an email.
Confirmation.processingSubtitle: Your bank is processing the payment (for example a 3D Secure check). Please do not pay a second time.
Confirmation.failedSubtitle: The payment could not be completed and you have not been charged. You can try again with the same or another card.
Confirmation.cancelledSubtitle: You cancelled the card payment. You have not been charged.
Confirmation.expiredSubtitle: The secure payment session expired before the payment was completed. You have not been charged.
Confirmation.reviewSubtitle: We received a payment notification that needs a manual check by our team. We will contact you by email; please do not pay again.
Confirmation.holdStillActive: This animal remains reserved for you until {time}.
Confirmation.holdReleased: Your reservation has ended. If the animal is still available, you can start a new order.
Confirmation.resumePaymentBtn: Return to the secure payment page
Confirmation.retryError: The payment could not be restarted. Please start a new order.
Confirmation.linkInvalidSubtitle: For your privacy, payment details are only shown through the secure link from your confirmation email or the order tracking page.
